caption: The video depicts a steam mop cleaning a vertical gray stall panel in a tiled restroom. At the opening the mop head, a gray microfiber pad with two yellow tabs on a black telescoping pole, is already gliding leftward across the panel's right half while a cloudy moisture pattern spreads across the surface. The white tiled wall and the curved edge of a urinal sit at the left, with a toilet base partly visible below the panel. As the head continues its leftward pass, an operator's hand in a plaid sleeve and wristwatch enters from the upper right to grip the pole, tilting it to follow the sweep. The mop reaches the left edge near the urinal, where vapor visibly rises around the pad. It then reverses direction and travels back rightward, the steam cloud re-forming and diffusing in its wake. In the last frames the head has returned to a center-right position, still pressed against the damp surface as the cleaning pass continues.
relations: Mop head gliding leftward across the gray panel causes a cloudy moisture pattern to spread on the surface.
Operator's hand entering from upper right grips the pole, tilting it to guide the mop's continued leftward sweep.
Mop reaching the left edge near the urinal produces rising vapor around the pad before reversing direction rightward.
Rightward travel of the mop head re-forms and diffuses the steam cloud in its wake toward a center-right position.
